metadata.description: OCI Generative AI catalog with CLI-authoritative pretrained inventory and documentation-enriched imported-model deployment data.

imported.note: Models available via OCI Generative AI Model Import. Requires a dedicated GPU cluster endpoint. Fine-tuned variants supported within ±10% of the base parameter count. Includes Oracle-listed compatible imported families reflected in the OCI Model Import documentation.
imported.unitSizeSource: OCI documentation — Managing Imported Models / Dedicated AI Cluster Unit Sizes

commands: OCI CLI limits value list --service-name ai-generative
primary.scope: active OCI regions queryable by the configured profile
limitations: CLI output is the sole source for this snapshot.
OCI CLI does not expose context windows, model tiers, use-case descriptions, or a definitive per-region on-demand access mode.
regionalInventory records observed lifecycle; it must not be treated as catalog.json pretrained regions access map.
clusterSizingByRegion contains tenancy service-limit names and values, not model-to-shape compatibility or proof that capacity is available.

secondary.role: Extension fields not exposed by OCI CLI, including context windows, tiers, descriptions, and inferencing-mode guidance.
